A white dwarf, §9cooled into a black dwarf§r. Sirius B burns nothing and has no upkeep: it runs in §9batches§r, and your job is to follow a cooling curve.

§5§lUNLOCK§r The T4 milestones:§9 147,456 L White Dwarf Matter§r from cycles never worse than Stable,§9 4 h Resonant§r, and §9one Deep Dark run§r on this Eye. Then:
- put the §9Subspace Cooling Core§r in escrow;
- build the §9second arms§r (stack 5: 4,697 Galactic Shell Plating) and bring compression to tier 5;
- put §9Star Chart: Sirius B§r in the slot. The neutron star goes out: one star per Eye.
§9First Cooling§r is your first batch. A mean yield of at least 0.9 with no fracture unlocks T5; fall short and the core stays for another try. The batch's Black Dwarf Matter comes out either way.

§5§lBATCHES§r Each batch takes§9 18,432 L White Dwarf Matter§r and assembles a white dwarf at Θ +90. Over§9 2 h§r (÷ the dial) the cooling setpoint ramps from §9+90 to −90§r; at T5 the Θ gauge reads your error from that setpoint. Output:§9 4,608 L Black Dwarf Matter × the batch's mean yield§r. EU: 3.87 × 10¹³ a cycle (about 16 A MAX).

§5§lSUBSPACE §lCOOLING§r Trims:
- Dimensionally Shifted Superfluid (100 L, up to 10 a second): Θ −1, P −0.5. The heat sink.
- Raw Stellar Plasma (1,000 L, up to 5): Θ +3, for an overshoot.
- Helium (1,000 L, up to 10): P +2, accretion pressure.
Decay heat pushes Θ up the whole way and crystallisation drags P down. Expect about§9 100,000 L of Superfluid a batch§r.

§5§lTHE §lPLATEAU§r While the setpoint crosses −10..+10 (about 800 s), latent heat adds §9Θ +0.15 a second§r. The event channel warns 15 s ahead.

§5§lAUTOMATE§r Θ reads the error from the curve, so one sensor pair on Θ drives the Superfluid valve all batch long; a pair on P drives Helium. Keep White Dwarf Matter stocked for the next charge.

[warn]§lFracture§r (Breach or Integrity 0) ends the batch at 25 % of its output × the fraction done.[/warn]

[note]One T4 Eye on the default feed makes about enough White Dwarf Matter for one T5 Eye.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold the core and the chart (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL: claim before the core goes into escrow).
